name: active-setup-persistence-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants an Active Setup component under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\<GUID> with a StubPath that runs a hidden PowerShell payload at every user logon (the per-user HKCU version value is absent, so the component runs). Vars: PAYLOAD_PATH (required); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional); COMPONENT_GUID (optional, default a fixed GUID); VERSION (optional, default '1,0,0,0'). The hardened state is the StubPath value gone (or the whole component key removed). Idempotent. Pairs with a registry_value check expecting StubPath absent.
